# Corporate Games: full text

Source: https://home.corporatetambola.com/ . Online games for company events, for the people you invite. A product of IT Services by Rajat Agarwal, B-1105, Shipra Krishna Vista, Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201014, India. E-mail hello@corporatetambola.com. Phone +91 96503 97480.

## Home (https://home.corporatetambola.com/)

You plan the day. The software makes the game run smoothly. Pick a game, share one link, and your people play together. We work closely with HR teams in organizing online events and games. Good for annual days, town halls, festive days, welcome days, team events and recognition evenings.

You can count on: designed for the engagement of company employees and their extended families; close group online engagement and fun; players never pay; only the people you invite can join; no app to install; no personal details needed, and all participant information is deleted within 24 hours of the game; a free Tambola or Bingo demo for 10 people.

## The games (https://home.corporatetambola.com/games)

- Corporate Tambola (https://housie.corporatetambola.com/): The classic number game, also called Housie.
- Corporate Bingo (https://bingo.corporatetambola.com/): Numbers are called out loud and every player gets a card on their phone.
- Corporate Tic Tac Toe (https://tictactoe.corporatetambola.com/): A one-against-one tournament for your whole company.
- Corporate Snakes and Ladders (https://snakes.corporatetambola.com/): Everyone gets their own board and plays at the same time.
- Corporate Luck by Chance (https://luck.corporatetambola.com/): A dice game of pure luck with a clock on every round.
- Corporate Lucky Draw: a live draw that picks the winners in front of everyone. Coming soon.

## Virtual team building games (https://home.corporatetambola.com/virtual-team-building-games)

One link, any phone, no app. For remote teams, hybrid teams and offices in many cities.

### What are virtual team building games?
They are games that people play together online instead of in one room. With Corporate Games, everyone opens one link on their own phone and plays at the same time.

### Can remote and hybrid teams play together?
Yes. People in the office and people at home join the same game from the same link.

### Do people need to install an app?
No. The game opens in the phone browser. There is no app and no password to remember.

### How do we start?
Pick a game, choose the day and time, and share one link with the people you invite. Building a game is free. You pay once for each game you run, before it starts.

### Can colleagues in different cities join?
Yes. All they need is the link and a phone with internet.

## Games for HR teams (https://home.corporatetambola.com/games-for-hr-teams)

You choose the game, the day and the time. You decide who joins. You give the prizes. The software makes the game run smoothly and finds every winner.

### What does an HR team need to run a game?
A game, a day and time, and the list of people to invite. You share one link. The software makes the game run smoothly and finds every winner.

### Who can join?
Only the people you invite. You also decide whether adult family members can come.

### Do employees have to pay?
No. Players never pay or stake money. The organizer gives the prizes. We provide software only.

### Which game suits an annual day or a welcome day?
That is your choice. Tambola and Bingo suit a whole group playing together. Tic Tac Toe suits a tournament. Tell us the occasion and the number of people, and we will help you choose.

### What happens to employee details after the game?
No personal details needed. All participant information is deleted within 24 hours of the game. See the Privacy and Data page for exactly what is kept and for how long.

### Can we talk to a person first?
Yes. Write to hello@corporatetambola.com or call (+91) 96503 97480.

## How it works (https://home.corporatetambola.com/how-it-works)

1. Choose a game. Set the day, the time and the size. Building a game is free.
2. Invite your people. Share one link by WhatsApp, e-mail or your intranet.
3. Play together. Players open the link on their own phone. The software finds every winner.

You get a report by e-mail a few minutes after the game ends. You pay once for each game, before it starts. There is no yearly plan.

## Pricing (https://home.corporatetambola.com/pricing)

Building a game is free. You pay once for each game you run, before it starts. Players never pay or stake money. The price is shown on each game's own page. The only payee is IT Services by Rajat Agarwal, the trade name of Rajat Agarwal, an individual running a sole proprietorship in India. The only way to pay is Razorpay. GST is not charged.

## Questions and answers

### What are the best online games for team building?
It depends on your group. Tambola and Bingo work when everyone plays together on one call. Tic Tac Toe is a one-against-one tournament. Snakes and Ladders lets everyone play at the same time. Luck by Chance is a quick dice game. All of them open in the phone browser, with no app to install.

### How to run housie for 200 employees?
Housie is another name for Tambola. Choose the day and time, share one link with the people you invite, and everyone opens it on their phone. The software gives out the tickets and finds every winner. Tell us your head count when you plan, and we will help you set it up.

### Is there an online tambola for corporate events in India?
Yes. Corporate Tambola is made for company events. Players join from a link on their phone, with no app, and they never pay. You pay once for each game you run, to IT Services by Rajat Agarwal, through Razorpay. A free demo for 10 people is available.

### Can remote and hybrid teams play together?
Yes. Everyone opens the same link on their own phone, in the office or at home. You can run the game alongside your usual video call.

### Do players need to install an app or pay?
No. Players open a link in their phone browser. They never pay or stake money. The organizer gives the prizes.

### How much does it cost?
Building a game is free. You pay once for each game you run, before it starts. There is no yearly plan. The price is shown on each game's own page before you pay.

### What happens to player details?
No personal details needed. All participant information is deleted within 24 hours of the game. The winners record, and the contact details a winner confirms for a prize, are kept for 365 days, then deleted automatically.
